info.title: RedSecTools API
info.description: Repository-only OpenAPI documentation for RedSecTools. This file is not served by the live application. It documents the current HTTP API, including auth requirements for main app, guest-link, extension, and admin routes. Survey and Wiki now include their active create/manage/respond/results/documentation route groups alongside the existing Paste, Share, Vault, Chat, Calendar, Homepage, Extension, and Admin surfaces.

AdminCookie.description: Signed admin session cookie for /admin/api routes.

ivPassword.description: Base64 12-byte IV used by the password re-encryption layer when hasPassword is true.

post.summary: Log in to the main web app
post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Depending on account state, this either creates a signed redsec_session cookie, starts MFA verification, or starts mandatory MFA setup.
Completes an MFA challenge using either a TOTP code or a recovery code. On success this creates the signed redsec_session cookie.

post.summary: Create MFA setup challenge during login
post.description: Used when MFA is required by policy but not yet configured for the user. Returns provisioning details and recovery codes for first-time setup.
Verifies the initial TOTP code for MFA setup during login and creates the user session cookie on success.
Clears the main user session cookie if present.
